title: Wisconsin Public Records Request — Forensic Autopsy Accession A-14-00305

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Dear Records Custodian,

Under Wis. Stat. §§ 19.31–19.39, I request records held by the University of Wisconsin Hospitals and Clinics Authority. This is a public records request, not a request for patient health records. The records relate to a forensic autopsy performed for the Marathon County Medical Examiner.

Case identifiers: Anatomic Pathology Laboratory Accession A-14-00305; decedent Stephanie Ann Low (DOB 09/29/1988); autopsy 21 September 2014, re-examination 23 September 2014; pathologist Michael Stier, M.D.; final diagnosis signed 31 October 2014; addendum signed 9 March 2017; Marathon County case 2014CF000860.

Period: 1 September 2014 – 30 June 2017.

Records requested:

Every version of the report for A-14-00305 held in the laboratory information system, including preliminary and provisional reports, the version signed 31 October 2014, the 9 March 2017 addendum, and the system's version or audit history showing when each was created, amended and signed.
Autopsy worksheets, body diagrams, bench notes and dictation.
All radiographs taken at the UW Morgue, including those taken through the body bag, with the dates and times they were taken.
Histology, immunohistochemistry and special stain records: requisitions, worksheets, results and slide and block inventories for sections 1A–1G and 2A.
Specimen retention and chain-of-custody records, including those for the portion of right thigh retained "for additional DNA analysis", and any records of its disposal.
Morgue intake and release logs, and sign-in records for 21 and 23 September 2014.
Requisitions, fax cover sheets, transmittals and correspondence with the Marathon County Medical Examiner, Wausau Police Department, the Wisconsin Department of Justice, NMS Labs (work order 17065120) or AIT Laboratories about this accession.
Invoices and billing records for this case.

Please provide the records electronically. If fees will exceed $50, please send an estimate first. If any part is withheld, please give written reasons as required by Wis. Stat. § 19.35(4)(b) and release the rest. Please preserve all responsive records under § 19.35(5).

Yours faithfully,
Emma

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Emma

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

All documents held by the County of Marin, Marin County Administrators Office, Marin County Coroners Office, regarding Diane Moyer, who died around March, 2021.

All documents held by the County of Marin, Marin County Administrators Office, Marin County Coroners Office, regarding Diane Moyer's estate and its administration between March 1, 2021 until October 29, 2026.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robbie Powelson
